rules.title: Prohibition on algorithmic rent-setting devices using nonpublic competitor data
rules.quote: The ordinance prohibits landlords from using qualifying algorithmic devices that calculate nonpublic competitor information to advise on rent or occupancy. Each month of use for each affected dwelling unit may constitute a separate violation, and tenants may seek damages, injunctive relief, and civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation.
rules.summary: Landlords cannot use algorithmic devices that use nonpublic competitor information to advise on rent or occupancy, with penalties up to $1,000 per violation.
rules.coverage_text: Each month of use for each affected dwelling unit may constitute a separate violation
rules.penalty: civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation; each month of use for each affected dwelling unit may constitute a separate violation

rules.title: Prohibition on algorithmic rent-setting devices
rules.quote: San Diego similarly authorizes tenant suits for damages, injunctive relief and penalties of up to $1,000 per violation, with each month and affected rental property potentially constituting a separate violation.
rules.summary: San Diego prohibits the use of algorithmic devices for rent-setting, with tenant suits authorized for damages and penalties up to $1,000 per violation.
rules.coverage_text: each month and affected rental property potentially constituting a separate violation
rules.penalty: penalties of up to $1,000 per violation, with each month and affected rental property potentially constituting a separate violation

rules.title: Prohibition on coordinated pricing algorithms
rules.quote: Prohibits coordinated pricing algorithms; recurring unit/month violations and private remedies
rules.summary: Berkeley prohibits the use of coordinated pricing algorithms, with recurring unit and month violations and private remedies available.
rules.penalty: recurring unit/month violations and private remedies

rules.title: Prohibition on anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing
rules.quote: Ordinance NS-3090 prohibits specified anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing; private tenant claims and up to $1,000 per violation and per month.
rules.summary: Santa Ana prohibits anticompetitive automated rent price-fixing, with private tenant claims and penalties up to $1,000 per violation and per month.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Santa Ana Ordinance No. NS-3090 (effective April 2, 2026)
rules.coverage_text: up to $1,000 per violation and per month
rules.penalty: up to $1,000 per violation and per month

rules.title: Prohibition on algorithmic rent coordination services
rules.quote: Prohibits a landlord's use of algorithmic rent coordination services; includes public and private enforcement; fines up to $2,000 per day.
rules.summary: Jersey City prohibits landlords from using algorithmic rent coordination services, with fines up to $2,000 per day.

rules.title: Prohibition on software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate rents
rules.quote: Prohibits landlords from using software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy.
rules.summary: Hoboken prohibits landlords from using software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy.

rules.title: Prohibition on algorithmic rent coordination services in Philadelphia
rules.quote: Philadelphia's ordinance permits an aggrieved person to elect statutory damages of $2,000 per violation or treble actual damages, together with equitable relief, interest and attorney fees and costs.
rules.summary: Philadelphia prohibits algorithmic rent coordination practices and allows aggrieved persons to elect statutory damages of $2,000 per violation or treble actual damages, plus equitable relief and attorney fees.
rules.penalty: statutory damages of $2,000 per violation or treble actual damages, together with equitable relief, interest and attorney fees and costs
